_meta.description: Curated UCSC campus landmarks for the navigation agent.
_meta.provenance: Hand-curated from public knowledge of the UCSC campus. NOT an official dataset.
_meta.coords_warning: Latitude/longitude are hand-estimated to roughly place each landmark relative to the others. They are adequate for relative positioning and for the curated walking graph, but they are NOT survey-grade and must not be used for precise geolocation or emergency routing.
_meta.elevation_note: elevation_ft values are approximate. UCSC rises from roughly 285 ft at the Main Entrance to well over 1,000 ft on upper campus; relative differences matter more here than absolute values.
_meta.replace_me: Swap this file for an official campus dataset when one is available; agents read it through common/loader.py and need no changes.

landmarks.name: Main Entrance (Bay & High)
landmarks.notes: Where most Metro buses enter campus. The lowest point of the main campus.

landmarks.name: Lower Quarry
landmarks.notes: Between the Main Entrance and the campus core.

landmarks.name: Quarry Plaza
landmarks.notes: The social center of campus. Bookstore, food, credit union, and the main bus hub.

landmarks.name: Bay Tree Bookstore
landmarks.notes: In Quarry Plaza. Textbooks, merch, and student ID services nearby.

landmarks.name: Quarry Amphitheater
landmarks.notes: Outdoor stone amphitheater. Hosts large all-campus gatherings.

landmarks.name: McHenry Library
landmarks.notes: Humanities, arts, and social sciences library. Long hours during term.

landmarks.name: Hahn Student Services
landmarks.notes: Financial aid, registrar, and student business services.

landmarks.name: Kerr Hall
landmarks.notes: Administrative offices.

landmarks.name: Cowell College
landmarks.notes: UCSC's first college (1965). Adjacent to Stevenson.

landmarks.name: Stevenson College
landmarks.notes: Adjacent to Cowell.

landmarks.name: Stevenson Event Center
landmarks.notes: Indoor venue used for fairs, performances, and large college events.

landmarks.name: Cowell/Stevenson Dining Hall
landmarks.notes: Shared dining hall for Cowell and Stevenson.

landmarks.name: Cowell Student Health Center
landmarks.notes: Primary care and urgent care for students.

landmarks.name: OPERS / East Field House
landmarks.notes: Main recreation complex: gym, pool, courts. Home of 'Late Night at Athletics & Rec'.

landmarks.name: East Field
landmarks.notes: Playing field next to the OPERS complex.

landmarks.name: East Upper Field
landmarks.notes: Site of the annual New Admit Class Photo and the Cornucopia festival.

landmarks.name: West Field House
landmarks.notes: Secondary athletics facility.

landmarks.name: Science Hill
landmarks.notes: Cluster of STEM buildings on the upper campus. A real climb from Quarry Plaza.

landmarks.name: Science & Engineering Library
landmarks.notes: STEM library on Science Hill.

landmarks.name: Baskin Engineering
landmarks.notes: Computer science and engineering.

landmarks.name: Physical Sciences Building
landmarks.notes: Physics and astronomy.

landmarks.name: Thimann Laboratories
landmarks.notes: Biology labs and large lecture halls.

landmarks.name: Sinsheimer Laboratories
landmarks.notes: Molecular biology.

landmarks.name: Humanities Building
landmarks.notes: Humanities lecture halls and offices, near McHenry.

landmarks.name: Social Sciences 1
landmarks.notes: Economics, psychology, and related departments.

landmarks.name: Social Sciences 2
landmarks.notes: Additional social sciences departments.

landmarks.name: Crown College
landmarks.notes: Upper campus, paired with Merrill.

landmarks.name: Merrill College
landmarks.notes: Upper campus, paired with Crown.

landmarks.name: Crown/Merrill Dining Hall
landmarks.notes: Shared dining hall for Crown and Merrill.

landmarks.name: Merrill Cultural Center
landmarks.notes: Event space used for cultural programming.

landmarks.name: College Nine
landmarks.notes: Upper campus, paired with John R. Lewis College.

landmarks.name: John R. Lewis College
landmarks.notes: Formerly College Ten. Renamed for Rep. John R. Lewis.

landmarks.name: College Nine/John R. Lewis Dining Hall
landmarks.notes: Shared dining hall for College Nine and John R. Lewis.

landmarks.name: College Nine/John R. Lewis Multipurpose Room
landmarks.notes: Indoor event room for college programming.

landmarks.name: Porter College
landmarks.notes: West campus, known for arts. Downhill from Kresge.

landmarks.name: Porter/Kresge Dining Hall
landmarks.notes: Shared dining hall for Porter and Kresge.

landmarks.name: Kresge College
landmarks.notes: West campus, uphill from Porter.

landmarks.name: Namaste Lounge (Kresge)
landmarks.notes: Kresge event and gathering space.

landmarks.name: Music Center
landmarks.notes: Recital hall and practice rooms, near Porter.

landmarks.name: Theater Arts Center
landmarks.notes: Theater department, studios, and stages.

landmarks.name: Mainstage Theater
landmarks.notes: Largest theater venue on campus.

landmarks.name: Rachel Carson College
landmarks.notes: Formerly College Eight. Environmental focus. Paired with Oakes.

landmarks.name: Oakes College
landmarks.notes: West campus, paired with Rachel Carson.

landmarks.name: Oakes/Rachel Carson Dining Hall
landmarks.notes: Shared dining hall for Oakes and Rachel Carson.

landmarks.name: UCSC Arboretum & Botanic Garden
landmarks.notes: On Empire Grade at the west edge of campus. Separate admission may apply.

landmarks.name: UCSC Farm & Garden
landmarks.notes: Working farm run by the Center for Agroecology, on lower campus.

landmarks.name: Cowell Ranch Hay Barn
landmarks.notes: Restored historic barn near the Main Entrance, used as an event venue.

landmarks.name: Barn Theater
landmarks.notes: Small performance space on lower campus.

landmarks.name: West Entrance (Empire Grade)
landmarks.notes: Secondary campus entrance on Empire Grade.

landmarks.name: East Remote Parking
landmarks.notes: Large remote lot on the east side, served by shuttles.

landmarks.name: West Remote Parking
landmarks.notes: Large remote lot on the west side, served by shuttles.

landmarks.name: Core West Parking Structure
landmarks.notes: Multi-level parking structure near Science Hill.

landmarks.name: Downtown Santa Cruz Metro Center
landmarks.notes: Central bus terminal downtown. Transfer point for most Metro routes.

landmarks.name: Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk
landmarks.notes: Site of the Boardwalk Frolic. Well off campus — take the bus, do not walk from campus.
